description:
Share one `SchemaEngine` across the issues repository validation evaluates, so each local rule's JSON Schema compiles once per report instead of once per issue.

## Background

- `evaluate_local` (`crates/jit/src/validation/local.rs:230`) desugars each matching rule's schema (`rule_schema`, `:272-278,343`) and builds a new `SchemaEngine` per call (`:289-290`). The engine already caches compiled validators by schema key (`crates/jit/src/validation/engine.rs:113-119`, `validator_for` `:317`, test `test_validator_is_cached_not_recompiled` `:947`), but the cache lives only for that one call.
- Repository validation calls `evaluate_local` once per issue (`collect_rule_findings`, `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:543-552`), so each schema compiles once per issue.
- Single-issue write paths also call `evaluate_local` (`commands/mod.rs`, `commands/template.rs`, `commands/bulk_update.rs`, `commands/gate_check.rs`, `commands/validate.rs`), as do its tests (`validation/local.rs`, `repository_state/default_rules.rs`, `tests/fast_docs_templates/content_format_dispatch.rs`, `tests/fast_rules/example_rulesets_tests.rs`, `tests/fast_rules/default_rules_registry_derivation_tests.rs`). `SchemaEngine` is `!Sync`, which suits a single-threaded report.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Local-rule evaluation accepts a caller's `SchemaEngine`, and repository validation evaluates every issue against one engine per report, so each distinct schema compiles once per report; no new compiled-rule-set type is introduced.
- [hard] REQ-02: `evaluate_local` keeps its signature and evaluates against an engine of its own, so its callers are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A unit test evaluates two issues against one shared engine and shows that a schema both match is compiled once.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Local rules compile each schema once per report
